name: C. F. Keil
bio:
Carl Friedrich Keil, German Lutheran scholar of the Old Testament, professor at Dorpat (now Tartu) and later living at Leipzig; a pupil of Hengstenberg, he defended the traditional authorship of the Old Testament books.

With Franz Delitzsch he wrote the Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament, which Keil began with the Pentateuch (1861-62); it was translated in Clark's Foreign Theological Library and is still reprinted.
